concepts.label: managed-object
concepts.gloss: A managed resource in the fault-management domain representing a network element (such as a router or a BGP session) that can be the subject of events and alarms.

concepts.label: event
concepts.gloss: An event record indicating something notable occurred on a managed resource, such as a syslog message or SNMP trap.

concepts.label: alarm
concepts.gloss: An alarm is a fault-condition record attached to a resource, optionally carrying a severity level and a probable cause.

concepts.label: severity
concepts.gloss: The seriousness level of an alarm, expressed as one of the predefined levels (critical, major, minor, or warning).

concepts.label: probable-cause
concepts.gloss: A code indicating the most likely root cause of an alarm, aligned with X.733 cause codes.

concepts.label: clear
concepts.gloss: An action that clears or acknowledges an existing alarm on a resource.
